main.CODE: chart-history, chart-rebased, chart-lvm, kpi:level, kpi:labour, kpi:materials — selects the general index, the index without labour and the four main groups
main.NAME_HE: chart-rebased — CBS's label, shown for a code the recipe has no short label for
main.FREQ: skip: constant M (the resource is fetched monthly only); rows of any other frequency are dropped
main.DATE: chart-recent, chart-history, chart-annual, chart-rebased, chart-lvm, chart-heat, insight:season
main.TIME_PERIOD: skip: the same month as DATE in another form
main.VALUE: recent, kpi:level — the published value on its own base, for contract readers
main.BASE_DESC: recent, kpi:level — the base each published value is on
main.PERCENT: chart-recent, chart-heat, kpi:mom, insight:latest, insight:biggest_month, insight:season
main.PERCENT_YEAR: chart-recent, chart-annual, chart-lvm, kpi:yoy, kpi:labour, kpi:materials, insight:yoy_trend, insight:labour_materials
main.VALUE_CHAINED: chart-history, chart-rebased, recent, insight:decades, insight:labour_materials — every month on the newest base
main.CHAIN_BASE: chart-history — names the base of the chained series
groups.CODE: chart-drivers, chart-decade, groups — selects the secondary groups; parents are left out of the rankings
groups.FREQ: skip: constant M (the resource is fetched monthly only); rows of any other frequency are dropped
groups.TIME_PERIOD: skip: the same month as DATE in another form
groups.VALUE: skip: the groups are shown as changes only; levels across bases come from VALUE_CHAINED
groups.BASE_DESC: skip: the groups are shown as changes only, so the base of each published value is not needed
groups.PERCENT: chart-drivers, groups — the published month-on-month change
groups.PERCENT_YEAR: chart-drivers, groups, insight:drivers — the published year-on-year change
groups.VALUE_CHAINED: chart-decade, groups — the cumulative change since the window start
groups.CHAIN_BASE: skip: the groups are shown as changes only, so the base name is not shown
